title: Steve Martin Presents with Andrew Dismukes and Michael Good
description: The long-running Sunday-afternoon showcase that borrows Steve Martin's name without him in it — Andrew Dismukes and Michael Good hosting, with Allison O'Conor, Wally Baram and Ashton Womack along for the ride, and an early 5pm start that leaves the rest of the Sunday open.

poster.alt: Steve Martin Presents with Andrew Dismukes and Michael Good at Union Hall — November 1, 2026 promotional artwork.

title: Kevin McDonald: My Stupid Career
description: The Kids in the Hall alum tells stories from a career he calls stupid, part talk and part one-man show, then stays for an audience Q&A that the ticket page invites you to point at world geopolitics — a Sunday night with a very specific kind of nerve in it.

poster.alt: Kevin McDonald: My Stupid Career at Union Hall — a photograph of Kevin McDonald.
poster.kind: performer photo from the event page

title: Fallback Comedy
price_label: $28.13 GA / $38.79 front row (per Eastville event page)
description: Eastville renames its Sunday closer for this date only: the 7:30pm set is billed as Fallback Comedy, with the lineup posted week-of and a two-drink minimum.

title: DF Sweedler, Thash Mose, Matt Pavich, Feraz Shere, Kareem Green, & More!
description: The Comic Strip's Sunday workshop night, with D.F. Sweedler's mic at the center and Kareem Green, Thash Mose, Matt Pavich and Feraz Shere already on the bill.

poster.credit: Artwork: The Comic Strip Comedy Club
poster.alt: DF Sweedler, Thash Mose, Matt Pavich, Feraz Shere, Kareem Green at Comic Strip Live Nov 1, 2026 — promotional artwork.

title: Frankenstein's Baby
description: The people behind Butterboy start their Monday show with Gondelman and Alison Leiby hosting and Liza Treyger, Shaun Anthoney, Nico Carney and Jonathan Van Halem on the bill, with music from Donwill between sets.

poster.alt: Frankenstein's Baby at Union Hall — the show's own artwork, a green monster head on a red brick wall.

title: Sam Oh: The Unbearable Tightness of Being...Gay Virgin
description: Sam Oh's NYC debut — part stand-up, part storytelling, part pop-concert fantasia on growing up evangelical and then everything else — with Sabrina Wu opening; a Monday-night Bell House taping ahead of his dates elsewhere.

poster.credit: Artwork: Live Nation / The Bell House
poster.alt: Sam Oh: The Unbearable Tightness of Being...Gay Virgin promotional artwork.

title: The Peter Stewart Show! With Kareem Green!
description: Kareem Green headlines the Monday 8pm set at the Strip, with Peter Stewart hosting — a working-night slot on a showtime résumé, 17+, two-item minimum in the showroom.

title: Hillbilly Allegedly: An Evening with the Vice President
description: Dan Wilbur does JD Vance as a full one-man show, rewriting the memoir and the old wrongs from inside the bit — a political impersonation sharp enough that the room decides what to believe.

poster.alt: Flyer for Hillbilly Allegedly: An Evening with the Vice President at Caveat, November 2, 2026, with Dan Wilbur pictured at the Washington Monument and a small inset of his Donald Trump impersonation.

title: Peyton Ruddy
description: Peyton Ruddy headlines the late slot at Union Hall, the comedian whose 'my best work' videos turned a start in the Chicago suburbs into a following you already know - ninety minutes in the basement room at the back of the bar, where the seating is first come.

poster.alt: Peyton Ruddy at Union Hall - the performer's photo, on the event page.
poster.kind: performer photo from the event page

title: Difficult People: The Movie — A Live Table Read
description: Julie Klausner and Billy Eichner stage Difficult People: The Movie as a live table read at Town Hall.

title: The Stand Presents: Francis Ellis, Caitlin Peluffo, Peyton Ruddy, & More!
description: Mark Normand on the bill without being named in the title, which is the reason to look twice at this Tuesday lineup at the Union Square room.

poster.alt: The Stand's Tuesday show card for November 3, 2026.

title: Michael Longfellow
description: Longfellow spent three seasons as a Saturday Night Live cast member and now headlines the Park Slope room on his own, which is a longer night than the sketch show ever gave him.

poster.alt: Michael Longfellow photographed at the Comedy Mothership, on the Union Hall event page.
poster.kind: performer photo from the event page

title: Infamous Ray
description: Ray Devito headlines the upstairs room on a Tuesday with a bill built for people who like their comics tight: Joe List, Todd Barry and Caitlin Peluffo on the card, plus Danny Polishchuk, Sherrod Small and Rebecca Reingold — an 8pm that clears out before the dinner crowd takes the room.

poster.alt: Infamous Ray at The Stand — the club's standing show card, which names Ray DeVito, Danny Polishchuk, Joe List, Todd Barry, Caitlin Peluffo, Sherrod Small and Rebecca Reingold and runs on the first Tuesday of the month.

title: Doctors Without Boundaries
price_label: $24.41 standard ($18.76 early bird ended Oct 28, $25 at the door)
description: An ER doctor breaks down the worst diagnoses four comics have had, then answers the audience's own embarrassing medical questions from a 'No Co-Pay' box — a health night that stays funny the whole way through.

poster.alt: Doctors Without Boundaries at Caveat - November 4, 2026 promotional artwork, naming Aaron Bola, Brittany Carney, Nadia Pinder, Jack Cloonan and Shafi Hossain.

title: Please Stay Seated
description: A Wednesday-night West Side show built for the room's small-stage energy — Jimmy Schatz slots his gossip-plus-bits format between real sets from Ben Kirschenbaum, Rachel Williams, Felicia Madison and Olga Namer, so the 75 minutes feel more like a tight hang at a friend's room than a stacked club bill.

poster.credit: Artwork: West Side Comedy Club / Jimmy Schatz
poster.alt: Please Stay Seated at West Side Comedy Club — November 4.

title: Cold Plunge with Kurt Braunohler
description: Kurt Braunohler hosts with Emmy Blotnick, Ahamed Weinberg and Nonye Brown-West on the bill — the Wednesday night that reads like a cold morning and plays like a hot one.

poster.alt: Flyer for Cold Plunge with Kurt Braunohler at Union Hall, November 4, 2026, naming Emmy Blotnick, Ahamed Weinberg and Nonye Brown-West.

title: Salma Hindy: 10 Years of Stand-Up Comedy
description: Salma Hindy takes The Stand's Upstairs room with Sabeen Sadiq and Denise Taylor opening — ten years of material in a tight, table-seated room that suits her set.

poster.alt: Salma Hindy: 10 Years of Stand-Up Comedy promotional artwork.

title: Nori Reed: Nori Is Present
description: Nori Reed was named Oakland's Next Great Comedian by SF Weekly and is one of Vulture's Comedians You Should Know, and this Union Hall hour - $20 general admission, mixed seated and standing, doors at 7 for a 7:30 show - is already sold out.

title: Sam Tallent
description: Elizabeth, Colorado's Sam Tallent — two specials on YouTube, a novel (Running the Light), and the Chubby Behemoth podcast — headlines Bell House. Black, blue, surreal and anti-humor in the room that helped put him on the map.

title: Angelo Colina en Harlem
description: A Venezuelan comic who tours the country in Spanish, and he does this one show only — so it is an hour of Spanish-language stand-up, which is rarer than it sounds.

poster.credit: Photo: Comedy In Harlem / show organizer
poster.alt: Angelo Colina headshot from the Comedy In Harlem event page.
poster.kind: performer headshot from the event page

title: Corinne Fisher, Priya Blunts, Peter Stewart, Rosey Catherine, Lauren Cocroft, Peter Gurl
description: Six comics and a two-drink minimum at the 120-seat room on Atlantic Avenue, cheap enough that the bar tab is the only real cost of the night.

poster.alt: Rosey Catherine, one of the seven comics on the November 5 Eastville bill.
poster.kind: performer photo from the event page

title: Stand-Up Comedy NYC | NYC's Best Weekly Thursday Show
price_label: From $13.06 ($12 super early bird, $15 early bird, $20 online, $25 at the door)
description: Harrison Greenbaum, Michael Good, Yvette Segan and Sam Rubinoff in the smallest room we cover — forty seats with a stage close enough that the comic can read your face.

poster.credit: Artwork: Upper East Side Comedy Club
poster.alt: The Thursday showcase at Upper East Side Comedy Club - the club's own image for the November 5, 2026 show, a comic performing on a late-night stage.

title: Jessie "Jetski" Johnson
description: A trumpet player who left music school for stand-up, on the Bad Friends podcast and a Kill Tony cast member, holding the 10pm slot at Union Hall three weeks before Thanksgiving.

poster.alt: Jessie "Jetski" Johnson photographed in the Union Hall room, on the event page.
poster.kind: performer photo from the event page

title: Hush Hush Comedy Show
description: The East Village cafe-bar that turns into a bar at night hosts a Friday showcase of touring names and local up-and-comers, and the ticket is twelve fifty with a one-item minimum, which makes it the cheapest ticket on our board that night.

title: Adam Ray
price_label: See Gramercy Theatre ticket page for price
description: Adam Ray opens NYCF at Gramercy Theatre with a night of character work and stand-up.

title: Gayme Show! starring Matt Rogers and Dave Mizzoni
price_label: See BMCC PAC ticket page for price
description: Matt Rogers and Dave Mizzoni bring their long-running Gayme Show to BMCC Tribeca PAC for NYCF.

title: Ms. Pat
venue: Hard Rock Hotel New York - The Venue on Music Row
price_label: See Hard Rock Hotel ticket page for price
description: Ms. Pat headlines the Hard Rock Hotel New York for the New York Comedy Festival opening weekend.

title: Ziwe
price_label: See Town Hall ticket page for price
description: Ziwe opens NYCF at Town Hall with a sharp, conversation-driving stand-up set.

title: Skintag and Friends
description: A festival-week Friday at Union Hall with Molly Kearney and Grace Johnson on the bill, which is the night to go if you want the room early rather than late.

poster.alt: Skintag and Friends at Union Hall — November 6, 2026 promotional artwork.

title: George Willborn: "The Stress Reliever"
description: The house MC at All Jokes Aside and a Def Comedy Jam regular, playing three shows across two nights uptown — the 8pm Friday is the easiest one to get into.

poster.credit: Artwork: Comedy In Harlem / show organizer
poster.alt: George Willborn: The Stress Reliever at Comedy In Harlem — Friday, November 6, 2026.

title: NY Comedy Festival Presents: Putería con PAPIROSSA: Celebration of Life
description: The eighth Putería con PAPIROSSA: a drag variety show with queer bipoc performers, a ceremonial dance opening number, taped sketches, stand-up and live music around one theme — a full show, not a showcase slot.

poster.credit: Artwork: New York Comedy Festival / Littlefield
poster.alt: New York Comedy Festival artwork for Putería con PAPIROSSA at Littlefield, November 6 at 8pm, a backlit silhouette in warm orange light.

title: The Best Indie Comedy Night in Williamsburg — Comics from Netflix & HBO
description: Six comics you have all seen on Netflix and HBO, including Amy Cardinale and Demetrius Jamal Fields, in an 8pm room on Grand Street.

title: Ken Boyd, Thash Mose, Craig Gass, Kyle Grooms, & Mike Yard
description: Five comics for the price of one ticket, with Craig Gass and Kyle Grooms on the same bill as the room’s own late slot.

title: Shaunak Does Improvised Standup
description: Shaunak improvises the set rather than working from a script, with Malik Elassal, Subhash Agarwal, Ismael Loutfi and Ryan Wentz in support - and it is the festival's late Friday slot in a Park Slope room.

poster.credit: Artwork: show organizer / New York Comedy Festival
poster.alt: Shaunak Does Improvised Standup at Union Hall - November 6, 2026 promotional artwork, with a portrait and the supporting lineup.

title: Drunk Black History
description: Brandon Collins hosts an hour and a half of Black history told tipsily, with a lineup of comedians, podcasters and writers on the panel, and it lands on a Saturday afternoon at 1:30 with no drink minimum.

poster.credit: Artwork: Caveat NYC / Drunk Black History
poster.alt: Drunk Black History at Caveat NYC - the show's own flyer art.

title: Charlie Flynn: Live at Union Hall
description: A five o'clock matinee in Park Slope: twelve dollars if you buy ahead, doors at half past four, and you are out of the room before the Saturday night starts.

title: New York Comedy Festival Presents: Ariel Elias
description: Ariel Elias has a new hour to show off, and it is an early 6pm slot with doors at 5:45 — you can catch it before dinner and still be home at a reasonable hour.

poster.credit: Artwork: New York Comedy Festival / Greenpoint Comedy Club
poster.alt: New York Comedy Festival Presents: Ariel Elias at Greenpoint Comedy Club — November 7, 2026 promotional artwork.

title: Joanne McNally: Pinotphile
price_label: See Town Hall ticket page for price
description: Joanne McNally brings Pinotphile, her sold-out hour about wine, weddings, and the chaos of being alive, to Town Hall.

title: Cattywampus with Ellen Skrmetti
description: Ellen Skrmetti brings her new hour — built around her book on what happens when life goes sideways — to the festival at the UWS room, a 6pm Saturday slot that runs before the dinner crowd.

poster.credit: Artwork: West Side Comedy Club / show organizer
poster.alt: Cattywampus with Ellen Skrmetti at West Side Comedy Club — November 7, 2026 promotional artwork.

title: Leg Day Comedy
description: Stand-up in a working gym on Ludlow Street, BYOB, billed as comics from Comedy Central, Netflix and SNL — and you do not have to set a single weight to be there.

title: Ken Boyd, Caroline Hanes, Craig Gass, Kyle Grooms & Mike Yard
description: Five working stand-ups with a showtime résumé — Craig Gass, Kyle Grooms, Mike Yard, Ken Boyd and Caroline Hanes — on the Saturday 8pm set at the Strip.

title: Nore Davis, Sima Sepehri, Greg Melly, Torrey Huggins, Janeane Garofalo, DJ Hairston
description: Janeane Garofalo on a Brooklyn bill at the Saturday 8pm show — a five-comic set at a room where the front row is close enough to hear the pause before the punchline.

poster.alt: Janeane Garofalo, one of the five comics on the November 7 Eastville bill.
poster.kind: performer photo from the event page

title: The Workout | New York Comedy Festival
description: The festival's official warm-up room, where headliners stop between their theatre dates to try material nobody has heard yet and rising comics play the tightest sets they've been building all year.

poster.credit: Artwork: Upper East Side Comedy Club / New York Comedy Festival
poster.alt: The Workout at Upper East Side Comedy Club - the club's own show card for the festival's warm-up room.

title: Greenpoint Comedy Club Presents: Adam Pally with The Nate Lang Band
description: Adam Pally backed by a live band and closing with a drum-led jam session — a comedy show with an actual music set in it, which is the strange, specific thing that makes this one worth the 9pm start.

poster.alt: Greenpoint Comedy Club Presents: Adam Pally with The Nate Lang Band — November 7, 2026 promotional artwork.

title: Secret Comedy Show
description: A glow-in-the-dark art studio in Hunters Point turns into a BYOB comedy room on the first Saturday of the month, with no drink minimum and no pushy servers, so the money goes to the comics.

poster.credit: Photo: The Spotlight Comedy (room photo from the show's own New York page)
poster.alt: The Secret Comedy Show room in Long Island City, lit up for a show.

title: Tessa and Freddie do Comedy at Union Hall
description: A 10pm set at Union Hall built around one theme — breakups and love — with Wally Baram and Charlie Bardey on the bill.

poster.credit: Artwork: show organizers (Tessa Belle & Freddie Shanel), Union Hall listing
poster.alt: Tessa and Freddie do Comedy at Union Hall — November 7, 2026 promotional artwork with the lineup.

title: Homeward Bound: a Korean Adoptee Exploring the Longing for Belonging
description: Jae Carelli is a lyric soprano as well as a Korean adoptee, and this Sunday matinee is part confession, part concert - the seven core issues of adoption worked through in original songs, in a Clinton Street room small enough that you can hear every note.

poster.alt: Homeward Bound at Caveat - November 8, 2026 promotional artwork, with a performer under blue and pink stage light and the title on the right.

title: Josh Sharp: An Hour of Crowd Work in the Round
price_label: See Bell House ticket page for price
description: Josh Sharp brings An Hour of Crowd Work in the Round to the Bell House for a NYCF matinee.

title: The Best Indie Comedy Night in Cobble Hill
description: Flop House's Sunday indie bill lands in a Bergen Street taproom, where the comics carry credits from HBO, Don't Tell and Netflix and $12.51 buys 90 minutes of it. It is a working bar with a stage in the back, which makes it the easiest room on the board to walk into on a Sunday without a plan.

poster.credit: Artwork: Flop House Comedy (via the Eventbrite listing)
poster.alt: Flop House Comedy flyer for The Best Indie Comedy Night in Cobble Hill.

title: Sarah Sherman & Patti Harrison
price_label: See Town Hall ticket page for price
description: Sarah Sherman and Patti Harrison share a Town Hall night as part of the New York Comedy Festival.

title: Very Good Comedy
description: A Sunday evening room on Allen Street with a name that tells you the billing is the point, and it runs an hour and twenty-nine minutes for fifteen seventy-one.

title: Marc Maron: Yammering Into the Void Tour
price_label: See Beacon ticket page for price
description: Marc Maron brings Yammering Into the Void to the Beacon as part of the New York Comedy Festival.

title: Rainbow Riot
price_label: See BCC ticket page for price
description: Rainbow Riot, the LGBTQ stand-up showcase hosted by Terrence Lambert, lands at Brooklyn Comedy Collective for NYCF.
